findings.summary: tryReadFileAtHead uses the shared git runner which calls .trim() on stdout, stripping all leading and trailing whitespace (including newlines and first-line indentation) from every file in the review context.
findings.suggested_fix: Use execa directly with stripFinalNewline: false to read raw file contents, bypassing the git-runner's automatic trimming.

findings.summary: isBinaryFile always returns false because git show --word-diff=porcelain on a binary blob exits with 0 instead of throwing, causing binary files to be included in the context.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the git show command with a direct content check for null bytes or use git diff --numstat.

findings.summary: Mismatched path resolution: changedFiles uses repo-relative paths (missing --relative flag), while trackedFiles and seedPaths use cwd-relative paths, causing git show HEAD:path to fail or load incorrect files when cwd is a subdirectory.
findings.suggested_fix: Use git diff --relative to ensure paths are cwd-relative, and use git show HEAD:./${filePath} to resolve files relative to the cwd.

findings.summary: isBinaryFile spawns an additional git process for every single file in the snapshot, causing a severe N+1 performance bottleneck.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the git process call in isBinaryFile and check for binary signatures directly in the string returned by tryReadFileAtHead.

findings.summary: git ls-files without -z quotes filenames containing spaces or non-ASCII characters, which breaks matching against the unquoted paths from changedFiles.
findings.suggested_fix: Run git ls-files -z and split by null bytes instead of splitting by newlines.

findings.summary: getSiblingTestCandidates only looks for tests in the exact same directory, completely missing tests located in __tests__ directories which are standard in this repository.
findings.suggested_fix: Add patterns to check for __tests__/${name}${suffix}.${ext} to accurately locate tests in this repository's structure.

findings.summary: Calling .trim() on each path returned by git diff -z breaks support for filenames that legitimately contain leading or trailing spaces.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the .trim() call in the .map() pipeline for changedFiles.
